title: Grilled Apricot with Verde Miel Glaze
description: A sweet and savory Italian dessert featuring grilled apricots topped with a verde honey glaze.
instructions: Brush apricot halves with olive oil and season with salt.
Grill apricots for 2-3 minutes per side or until caramelized.
Meanwhile, reduce balsamic vinegar in a small saucepan until thickened.
In a separate saucepan, combine verde honey and green food coloring (if using).
Bring honey mixture to a simmer over low heat.
Brush grilled apricots with reduced balsamic vinegar and then with verde honey glaze.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and serve immediately.
